summary: Last week's report said a fourth Instagram episode should trigger owner-level escalation. It arrived on Aug 26. Paige posted a screenshot and '@fonta' at 08:37; Vivek answered 97 minutes later with 'Hey', asked for a different screenshot, and the thread then stalled overnight. On Aug 27 Mayson — a chatter, not the Meta rep — had to bump it in front of the client with '@fonta ^'. Vivek's response was 'Send logins', the fifth credential request of the relationship, and Paige pasted '@paigeeleighhxx' with 'password i think is [REDACTED-PASSWORD] or [REDACTED-PASSWORD]'. Two things in that one message should stop the room: she is guessing at her own password, and neither guess is '[REDACTED-PASSWORD]', the password she set six days earlier when Vivek closed the Aug 21 episode — so the Aug 21 'fix' has already evaporated. The handle is also different from the 'xpaigex18' he has been working on all month and nobody asked which account this is. Vivek's last word in the window is 'Okay' at 10:26 on Aug 27; 23 hours later the issue is still open. This is the first IG episode to cross a week boundary unresolved — the previous three all closed inside a session. Meanwhile the security remediation from Jul 29 is now 30 days overdue with a fifth plaintext exposure added to the pile, Derrek's 'plenty of updates starting next week' is 27 days and four report weeks silent, Mica has now missed reel inspo two weeks running (last sent Aug 13, 15 days) and the 1-on-1 is 53 days unbooked, and Michelle is 41 days silent. Money is the one bright spot: Stephski nudged on Aug 26 and Paige replied 'i already sent it babe x' with a screenshot — she had paid the Aug 1-14 invoice without telling anyone. Stephski has not confirmed receipt, which matters more than usual because that invoice carried a changed account number.
